purpose: Long-form B2B sales narrative for a specific customer segment — many bespoke mid-page sections stitched around a shared hero/stats/contact/footer shell. Each of the 2 routes using this template has a distinct bespoke section sequence in the middle; only the shell nodes are shared.
notes: This is a 'flexible spine' template, not a fixed one: correspondent-banking and property-management are each bespoke long-form pages that share the shell (header/hero-narrative/stats-band/contact-form-panel/site-footer) but differ in which optional mid-page sections they include and how many workflow-feature-panel instances they use.

Given the scope-guidance to not over-invest in one-off pages, the bespoke mid-page sections are modeled as the general-purpose workflow-feature-panel/dashboard-preview-panel/sticky-feature-showcase/product-cross-sell-panel/logo-credentials-band types rather than a distinct component per page.
